Maharashtra Mandates Marathi Language for Transport Drivers

Maharashtra's transport department has mandated that all taxi, auto-rickshaw, and app-based cab drivers must possess practical knowledge of the Marathi language. This rule, effective from August 15, will be enforced through verification drives, with non-compliance potentially leading to license suspension. The state transport minister announced that stricter actions will be taken against those who fail to meet the requirement.
